title: Lekalo expression built-in capability snapshot (v1.0.0)
description: Issue #66 managed mode: the capability snapshot a target or adapter declares. Validating or generating an attachment against a snapshot that lacks a required capability token (`expression.core` or one `expression.builtin/<name>` per used built-in) blocks managed generation with `expression.builtin-unsupported`; the escape hatch is the foreign implementation family (issue #30).
